review.rationale: The frozen Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this pending-decision case. It preserves REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001, the repository identity/base commit and paired-case identity. DEC-001 materially affects the public rejection contract and is explicitly unresolved; the expected blocked readiness, requirement-decision-pending reason and evidence stopping at decisions correctly prohibit choosing an option or generating assignable tasks. Empty assignment expectations agree with that stop, while TASK-IMPLEMENT and TASK-VERIFY remain conditional on later resolution. The complete implementation-owner evidence supports source/index.ts and source/options.ts as the binding owner set. The supplied regression excerpts and complete type-test/build configuration establish relevant inspection and validation scope without implying tests were executed; generated dist declarations are not separately maintained owners. The empty team catalog does not authorize assignments, but neither assignment capability nor the later independent-review prerequisite must be satisfied before the earlier deterministic decision block. The Gold and preview release fingerprints agree across repository, evaluation source, team, decision inputs, prompt versions, model, sampling and policy. Supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and whitespace-only PRD persistence normalization. Original preparation placeholders are distinguished from the subsequently frozen preview inputs. Project reuse retains historical operations without supplying historical candidate outputs or copying attestations, consistent with review before any candidate on this bundle. Approval relies on the supplied Service mechanical bindings, not independent digest recomputation, code execution or human attestation.
